Status codes 401/403/404/409 in hireops_rules.md:21-23,78 are product contract, not grader machinery. integration.md equals the frozen template integration.md plus a symlink-delivery paragraph; template instruction/notes are CHANGE_ME placeholders, so task text is task-authored with no CHANGE_ME residue.
